You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

Please check it fast. I need to return the air purifier and the canister vacuum cleaner, and I want to know the total refund amount I should expect. Also, I really need the refund as soon as possible—within 3 days if at all possible.
